newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets 5-31/32 pct rate on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets 5-31/32 pct rate on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England set an unchanged rate of 5-31/32 percent on repos and secured loan facilities starting on November 7, 8 and 11.
The rate is the same as that currently applying to the Bank's day-to-day money market repos.
The two-week maturity repo will mature on November 21, 22 and 25. The four-week maturity will mature on December 5, 6 and 9.
The Bank will announce the amounts to be allotted in the repos at around 1130 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7708
